headlines.title: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania outbreak, health officials say
headlines.description: They are the first measles-related deaths in the U.S. this year.

headlines.title: Health Officials Report 2 Measles-Related Deaths in Pennsylvania
headlines.description: Health officials say two people have died in Pennsylvania after being infected with measles. Both of the individuals from Lancaster County were unvaccinated. They are the first measles-related deaths in the United States this year.

headlines.title: Two deaths reported in Pennsylvania measles outbreak
headlines.description: Two people have died of measles in Pennsylvania, the state’s health department confirmed Tuesday. Both people were unvaccinated. They are the first such deaths in the U.S. this year, and the first in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania in 35 years.

headlines.title: FDA Approves New Blood Test to Identify Signs of Alzheimer’s
headlines.description: The Food and Drug Administration has approved a new blood test to help identify signs of Alzheimer’s disease for people 55 and older who are already showing signs of cognitive decline. The test, from pharmaceutical company Roche and partner Eli Lilly, is a bio-marker blood test.

headlines.title: What is postpartum psychosis? The mental health condition is at the center of the Lindsay Clancy trial
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s lawyers say a rare mental health condition caused her to kill her three children. So what is postpartum psychosis, and why is it so difficult to diagnose and treat? NBC News' Erika Edwards reports.
